item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day has real structure around it — meals anchor a lot of what's on the schedule. Don't let back-to-back commitments push eating into an afterthought squeezed between tasks. Eat on purpose, not on autopilot. One action: before your midday stretch gets busy, actually pause and eat a real meal, seated, no multitasking.
